description: Shibaji Chakraborty and colleagues publish SCUBAS, a reusable Python package for modelling geomagnetic induction along submarine cables. Zenodo archives the TLM-0.1.3 release as Other Open; the linked repository identifies an MIT licence and documents package installation, notebooks and a Python package index entry. The model treats ocean and Earth conductivity as a transmission line and estimates the potential profile from coast to coast during magnetic disturbances. The simulations can help explore cable exposure to space-weather events under alternative geophysical and route assumptions. No catalogue record explicitly covers this submarine-cable modelling package. A limitation is that the examples use simplified ocean configurations; real route calculations require suitable conductivity, bathymetry and magnetic-field inputs. The current repository may differ from the 2023 archive. No package was installed or run, and coast-potential estimates were not reproduced.
